author: Spoookeh
body:
You guessed it.

For starters, I'm not even that good. Put me in a fight against the likes of Lg, Raging and Budah and they'll beat me any day. 


The ban was false, I did not hack. I was banned for aimbot and safe aura; I have had multiple people already message me saying that the ban was stupid. If you want evidence, here: http://imgur.com/a/bEUnb Wait until  EU times and that number will at least triple.

Like I stated on my public post. I do not hack, I never have and never will. I feel like I've been stabbed in the back. I worked hard for the staff position for it to be snatched away from me by harsh and false accusations from people who clearly don't know what they're talking about anymore.

You've caused people to lose faith in me and my friendships to break down. Hope you're happy.


As for the 'evidence' of me hacking. It's some of the worst I have ever seen. 

1:47 on this video (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5-LfO2c0Ys0) This is the only ever case showing aimbot that the staff has cared to share with me. Why would I use aimbot for one fight and never again or before? I was lagging and only made 1 hit; great aimbot there.

A bit later in the same video when I was fighting Loo, I was accused of safe aura (2:44). If you cared to slow it down you would see that I only have 1 unexplained hit. As seen from the previous clip I was lagging, also the server is hosted in California while I live in London. I'm not sure how to explain that 1 hit but if that's enough to ban someone I've lost faith.

Don't even get me started on this https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fd_zbNpB578. All my hits that I've seen are inside the hitbox and none show any sign of safe aura. Could I also point out that Iron isn't even looking at me when he hits me one time? I'm not accusing Iron, just showing how screwed up Avicus can be sometimes.

The new staff policy is that the staff member who punished the player is the only one allowed to reply to the appeal. I don't mind others replying but don't send Stim and Tazz to do your dirty work for you.

I'm not throwing accusations around at all but: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CjgKtoWbk_Y 2:48, slow it down.
I'm the one being banned? nice.

title: Ban Appeal

replies.author: Tazz
replies.body:
First of all, how much evidence have you shown them? It seems as if you've only showed them the whole video of your scrim against PPB.

Furthermore, you can not get one odd hit. That is impossible in minecraft.

Idk who is going to be doing your appeal, however it probably won't be Ethan.

I'm not throwing accusations around at all but: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CjgKtoWbk_Y 2:48, slow it down.
I'm the one being banned? nice.

First of all, yes you are throwing around accusations. Second of all, I don't actually flick on to Notal, nor is it anywhere close to the center of his hitbox. In a thehen101 client (his clients are the most popular because they're all leaked), his aimbot is based off of angles. Essentially it is pulled to an angle between 0-360. When the degree of the rotation bits 360, instead of slowly decreasing to 0, it snaps.  I only go about 80 degress, which proves my innocence in that clip.
